title: Horizon+
description: A full vanilla performance and quality of life modpack :)
body:
**Horizon+**

A carefully selected collection of client-side mods, resource packs, and shaders designed to improve Minecraft's visuals, performance, quality of life, and immersion while keeping the vanilla gameplay experience intact.

**Features
Performance Improvements**

This pack includes numerous optimization mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, EntityCulling, Dynamic FPS, and more to provide higher FPS, faster loading times, and smoother gameplay.

**Better Visuals**

Enjoy an enhanced Minecraft experience with features like:

Distant Horizons for extended render distances
Iris shader support
Dynamic lighting
Better entity models and textures
Animated and immersive visual effects
Improved particles, weather effects, water wakes, and sound physics

**Quality of Life**

The pack adds many useful tools and interface improvements:

Xaero's Minimap and World Map
Better F3 screen
Better statistics tracking
Inventory management improvements
Shulker Box previews
Zoom functionality
More chat history
Config menus and customization options

**Building & Creative Tools**

Builders can take advantage of powerful tools such as:

Axiom
Litematica
Freecam
Orthographic Camera
Multiplayer Features
Simple Voice Chat support
Various chat enhancements and player interaction improvements

**Why use this pack?**

This modpack is designed for players who want Minecraft to look better, run faster, and feel more modern without changing the core vanilla gameplay. It combines performance optimizations, visual upgrades, and quality-of-life features into a single easy-to-install package.

**Included Mods**

The pack contains over 80 carefully selected client-side mods, including Sodium, Iris, Distant Horizons, Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map, Litematica, Axiom, Simple Voice Chat, BetterF3, Zoomify, and many more.

**Server Compatibility**

Most mods are client-side and can be used on vanilla servers. However, Freecam, Health Indicators, and ClientSort may be considered unfair advantages on some servers. Always check the server rules before using them.
